headline: Marvin Harrison Jr. Passes Texans Physical; Houston’s Week 5 Result Affected Trade?
summary: The Cardinals and Texans’ Marvin Harrison Jr. trade is now official. The third-year wide receiver passed his Texans physical Monday and will begin preparing to make his Houston debut. Arizona will receive 2027 second- and seventh-round picks from Houston for the former No. 4 overall pick. For a bit, it looked like the Cardinals would add […]

headline: 49ers' Dre Greenlaw suspended one game for head-butting helmetless Seahawks LB
summary: 49ers linebacker Dre Greenlaw has been suspended for one game without pay for unsportsmanlike conduct during Sunday's game against the Seahawks.

headline: Cowboys bring in Mike Pettine to assist first-year DC Christian Parker
summary: The struggling Dallas Cowboys are bringing in longtime NFL coach Mike Pettine as a senior defensive assistant to work with first-year DC Christian Parker.

headline: Deebo Samuel to miss time with hamstring injury, Nick Bosa could return this week
summary: The 49ers are going to be down another wide receiver in the coming weeks.

headline: Dolphins' Jeff Hafley says he's not mulling QB change entering bye
summary: Dolphins coach Jeff Hafley is not considering a quarterback change heading into their Week 6 bye, but he did say the passing offense must improve.

headline: Commanders' Quinn says 'no one is pleased' after botched play fuels fan angst
summary: Commanders coach Dann Quinn explained the breakdown that caused a botched final play in Sunday's overtime tie, saying it's ultimately his responsibility.
